name: Laiba
greetingText: Tum jaise dost paana Allah ki nemat hai 🌸
wishText: Tumhari zindagi rangon se bhari ho, har subah nayi umeed le kar aaye. Allah tumhein hamesha khush rakhe, tumhari har mushkil door kare, aur tumhari har dua ko qubool farmaye. Duniya ki har khushi tumhare qadmon mein ho. 🌟❤️
text1: Aaj ka din sirf tumhara hai! 🎂🌸
textInChatBox: Happy Birthday Laiba! 🎉 Ye choti si koshish hai tumhein muskurane ke liye. Ummeed hai pasand aayegi! 💖
text2: Maine socha tumhe kuch khaas doon...
text4: Phir socha, kuch aisa jo dil ko chhu jaye,
outroText: Batao, tumhe yeh kaisa laga? Sach sach bataana! 😊
replayText: Agar dil chahe toh dobara dekh lo 💕
